instruction: Look at fixture_complex.step in NX CAM. Set the four fixture blocks in fixture_complex.step as fixture/check geometry. Create safe toolpaths for the central pocket and outside profile while maintaining at least 4 mm clearance from every fixture whenever Z is below 20 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for roughing and T2 is a 6 mm end mill for finishing while respecting check geometry. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17.nc.
